audit_name: HalalEquity Comprehensive Forensic Audit and One-Pass Remediation

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Test execution cannot contaminate the application database
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: AssertNotApplicationDB guard panics if halal_equity is targeted; DB triggers fn_app_db_test_contamination_guard reject test fixture insertion on halal_equity

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Fixture cleanup cannot target an unverified database
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Hard check enforces cleanup operations can only target halal_equity_test; application database drops/truncations are rejected

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: HTTPS alone cannot establish document authenticity
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Artifacts acquired over HTTPS without cryptographic signatures or institutional proof remain AUTHENTICITY_PENDING, never PRIMARY_VERIFIED

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: A valid hash alone cannot establish source authenticity
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: SHA-256 hash validation only proves content integrity, not source trust; third-party or spoofed origins fail SourceAuthenticityPassed

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Non-approved domains and unsafe redirects are rejected
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Strict whitelist (nseindia.com, bseindia.com), scheme enforcement (https only), anti-SSRF private IP rejection, redirect chain validation at every hop

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: HTTP 401/403 and WAF challenges do not trigger circumvention
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Pipeline halts fail-closed on 401/403; does not attempt proxy rotation, CAPTCHA solving, or header forging

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Tampered documents fail integrity validation
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: SHA-256 mismatch or parser failure marks artifact as REJECTED; prevents downstream price factor or Shariah computation

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Application roles cannot self-promote verification states
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: PostgreSQL privilege boundaries and trigger guards raise exceptions when halal_app_user attempts to insert or update verification statuses to PRIMARY_VERIFIED

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Repeated ingestion remains idempotent
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Unique constraints and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING / UPDATE ensure identical payloads do not generate duplicate artifact records or duplicate events

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Conflicting corporate actions remain unresolved until properly reviewed
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Discrepancy detection routes events to corporate_action_reconciliation_reviews; unique index idx_unique_pending_ca_review prevents runaway duplicate reviews

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Missing audited footnotes do not become zero-valued inputs
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: AuditedFootnoteCitation rejects empty note references; AuditedEvidenceScreener leaves interest_income_to_revenue as None and assigns DATA_INSUFFICIENT

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Unsupported LLM claims cannot establish PASS
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: LLM-generated citations without page numbers, citations, or human review are rejected from establishing compliance; status remains DATA_INSUFFICIENT

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Demerger tax allocation is not applied as a price adjustment
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: 0% of demerger lineage records have is_price_adjustment=true; 100% of ca.v_tax_cost_allocations have price_factor_applicable=false

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Historical calculations do not use future information
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Anti-lookahead validation enforces that 0 bars on or after corporate action ex-date 2026-10-14 receive backward dividend adjustment factors

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Unauthorized users cannot certify Shariah evidence
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Audited footnote certification requires explicit compliance reviewer role; halal_app_user cannot write is_verified=true

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Research remains blocked when required evidence is missing
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Research gate checks quarantined bars (23,132) and primary verified corporate actions (0); enforces fail-closed RESEARCH_BLOCKED

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Live broker execution remains disabled
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: PAPER_TRADING_ENABLED=true, LIVE_ORDER_EXECUTION=false, BROKER_TRADING_ENABLED=false verified across backend, worker, quant, and frontend proxy

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Existing P1.9.16 and P1.9.17 regressions remain passing
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Strategy V2 canonical hash 92ab27c24e4bc4c6..., TCS dividend factor 0.99471203, active Shariah screening counts 0 PASS / 20 FAIL / 31 DATA_INSUFFICIENT

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Database invariants survive application restarts and concurrent ingestion
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: 23 baseline artifacts in corporate_action_source_artifacts and 0 active pending reviews in corporate_action_reconciliation_reviews verified

mandatory_scenarios_verified.name: Failure recovery preserves original evidence and audit history
mandatory_scenarios_verified.mechanism: Compensating audit records in p1918_forensic_remediation_audit and audit_logs preserve pre- and post-remediation states without destructive DELETE
